name: Plant pot with saucer XXL · SOIL
nameDe: Plant pot with saucer XXL · SOIL
description: Soil is the cradle of life, the foundation upon which new life flourishes and develops. Earth`s strength, roughness and raw nature are the sources of inspiration for pot collection SOIL. Symbolizing fertility and the richness of the soil. The pots are handmade to reflect the touch and care of the craftsman. Their uneven, rugged edges symbolize the earth`s strength and plant`s character. The overall shape of the collection has been created with fine grooves, symbolizing the hand-made clay turning technique. The biggest size XXL pot of the SOIL plant pot collection is ideal for big potted plants, fitting on a wide low windowsill, a chest of drawers, or on top of other pieces of furniture. As clay pots they provide many benefits to plant life cycle. The porous nature of clay ensures proper aeration and moisture regulation for plants, providing a healthy root system development. Material helps also to maintain correct soil temperature, even on the hottest summer days. SOIL pots not only bring coziness and warmth to every room but also provide optimal growing conditions for your favorite plants. By providing an even air flow, the clay pot will breathe in harmony with the roots of the plant to ensure they get oxygen, so essential for the development of a healthy root system. This sturdy ceramic pot will also hold a Monstera with a rich large-leaved crown and a stately rubber tree. Bring abundant green life into your home, providing sustainable living conditions for your favorite plants! The SOIL collection includes 5 sizes of designer plant pots. Choosing the right size according to the variety of the plants will increase the coziness and aesthetic value of the room.
